The Source

Coconut: one of nature's best
sources of electrolytes.

Coconuts have been fueling people for thousands of years, long before electrolyte powders, sports drinks, or supplement labels ever existed. The coconut is naturally rich in potassium and other key electrolytes your body depends on. It's not a fortified product or a manufactured solution. It's just what the fruit does on its own.

Studies suggest that roughly 95% of Americans don't get enough potassium in their daily diet. Most people aren't even close. Palms is one small way to change that.

I grew up drinking coconut water every chance I got. There's something about it, a lightness after you finish it, a feeling that your body actually got something real. I became obsessed with harnessing that in a way people could genuinely enjoy every single day. Not a supplement. Not a health shot. A frozen dessert. Something you actually want to eat.

Palms is for everyone who wants to feel good about what they're eating without giving up on taste. The athlete who cares about what goes in. The person who reads labels. The one who just wants something delicious that doesn't leave them feeling worse than before they ate it. Whatever brings you here, Palms was made with you in mind.

The Story

Dairy-free frozen dessert
that doesn't taste like it.

My mother has been dairy-free her entire life. And for as long as I can remember, that meant eating the sad version of everything. The ice cream that tasted like frozen air. The substitute that reminded you it was a substitute. She never complained, but I paid attention. Nobody should have to settle just because of what their body can and can't handle.

I grew up loving coconuts and spent years drinking coconut water after workouts. When I started thinking about making my own frozen dessert, it wasn't a complicated decision. Coconut milk is naturally dense and rich, the kind of base that actually holds texture, flavor, and creaminess without pretending to be something it isn't. The result surprises people every time. Not coconut-flavored. Not watered down. Just something that tastes genuinely good.

Made in Houston. Built so that doing better doesn't mean settling for less.
